en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Salih Bin Uqba, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,

‘A neighbour of mine married a woman. So when he intended to copulate with her, she kicked him with her leg and ruptured his testicles, so they became swollen. So after that he copulated with her and she gave birth to a child for him. So I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about that, and about a man whose navel was ruptured. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Regarding all ruptures is a third of the wergild’.
